response.sql: WITH filtered AS (SELECT sf.zoneref, s.entrystat, sf.traitcount FROM scanfeatures sf INNER JOIN sites s ON sf.zoneref = s.zoneregistry WHERE sf.traitcount >= 489), total AS (SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM filtered) SELECT f.zoneref, f.entrystat, AVG(f.traitcount) as avg_traitcount, COUNT(*) as record_count, COUNT(*) * 100.0 / t.cnt as share FROM filtered f, total t WHERE t.cnt > 0 GROUP BY f.zoneref, f.entrystat, t.cnt ORDER BY share DESC, CASE WHEN f.entrystat IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: "passes the 489 threshold" means traitcount >= 489 (meets or exceeds), not > 489 (strictly exceeds)

alternatives.interpretation: "passes the 489 threshold" could mean traitcount > 489, excluding records with exactly 489
